response.sql: SELECT r.name, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId WHERE cs.points > 6.0 GROUP BY r.name

assumptions.assumption: "Clear the 6.0-point threshold" means strictly greater than 6.0 (points > 6.0), so entries with exactly 6.0 are excluded.

Race names with no qualifying entries do not appear in the output, because the filter is applied before grouping. Rows with NULL wins are ignored by AVG, and AVG returns NULL if all wins values in a group are NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: Threshold is inclusive: entries with points >= 6.0 are kept.
